segments.speaker: Grace Hall
segments.text: Let's review the marketing budget for next quarter. We have forty thousand dollars approved so far.

segments.speaker: Omar Said
segments.text: Most of it should go to events. The industry conference alone costs about fifteen thousand dollars.

segments.speaker: Grace Hall
segments.text: That seems high. Can you get a quote for a smaller booth?

segments.speaker: Omar Said
segments.text: Sure, I will ask the organizers for a smaller booth quote this week.

segments.speaker: Grace Hall
segments.text: Great. I'll update the budget spreadsheet once we have the quote, and we can decide on Monday.
